rule: The ending pattern is the last letter of the opening, plus the hinge, plus the ending (EQUAZIA: a + z + ia = azia), searched as a suffix wildcard (*azia). The substitutions that apply to the hinge and the ending are applied to it, one at a time, up to the ending cap.
why: A mark that shares the tail of the applicant's mark can share its commercial impression even with a different opening; the extra letter of the opening keeps the suffix from matching every word that ends in -ia.
